contents: # El Niño watch (uhifadhi/el-nino-module) — the Pacific this week, the chance
# El Niño lasts into the short rains, the rain of the last weeks over an area,
# and who loses road access if it floods: one bulletin a week, posted by the
# producer each area names on its configure page.
# NOTHING BELOW IS REQUIRED. Every key has a default, and the tree is CLOSED, so
# an invented key fails at compile time rather than being ignored.
# WHAT THIS MODULE STANDS ON. Everything that is not about the watch arrives
# with `uhifadhi/uhifadhi`: the per-area catalogue this module's tile is filed
# in (registry), the page frame (shell), the ground and its overview (area) and
# the maps and charts every plate draws with (atlas).
el_nino:
# Which catalogue category the El Niño watch tile is filed under in every
# area. PRESSURE, because a flood season is pressure ON the ground and the
# people who work it, not the rangers' own work.
module_category: pressure
# The most bytes one part of a producer's push may carry. The susceptibility
# polygons alone are about two megabytes; sixteen leaves room.
ingest_body_cap: 16777216
# How many of the weeks a bulletin carries the week-by-week tab walks through.
weeks_shown: 26
# THE ONE LINE THIS INSTALLATION WRITES ITSELF, in config/packages/security.yaml.
# The producer posts its bulletin to /el-nino/ingest, and a producer is not a
# person: the bearer token issued on the module's configure page is the whole
# of its authentication. A recipe cannot edit the access rules — they are the
# installation's own, by Symfony's design — so open the address above the
# catch-all yourself:
#   access_control:
#       - { path: ^/el-nino/ingest$, roles: PUBLIC_ACCESS }
#       - { path: ^/, roles: ROLE_USER }
# Without it a producer's push is turned away at the sign-in form.
# El Niño watch screens (uhifadhi/el-nino-module) — the overview and the
# week-by-week walk under their area, /areas/{uuid}/modules/elnino/…, the
# producer section's writes, and the ingest door the producer posts to at
# /el-nino/ingest.
# The addresses are the controllers' own, declared as attributes beside the code
# that answers them. This file is what mounts them, and it is yours: remove the
# import and the screens are gone from `debug:router` with nothing left behind.
el_nino:
resource: '@UhifadhiElNinoBundle/src/Controller/'
type: attribute
